sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 318 x 181 x 44 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Dealer pages (B&H, Adorama, Music Radar review) and the manual read through a search summary 2026-11-12: one USB Type-B port (bus powered, class compliant, MIDI over USB) and one 1/4 in TS sustain-pedal jack; no DIN MIDI. The pedal jack has no catalogue signal (not a port). 318 x 181 x 44 mm (dealer, size ok); the real unit is a slightly sloped slab, modelled as a flat rounded box (the family has no profile). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
